subject: Temporary no-PO onboarding request — NimbusWorks (pilot)
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sara Patel <sara@nimbusworks.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbusworks.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Temporary no-PO onboarding request — NimbusWorks (pilot)

Hi team,

NimbusWorks (Sara) has asked to start a short pilot integration this month. They are a small engineering shop; the pilot is scoped as a one-off connector build and 30-day support window. Estimated spend for the pilot: ~$6,500 (one invoice at completion). They are requesting to onboard immediately and invoice rather than wait for a standard PO, since legal/finance cycles would push the pilot past their internal deadline.

Controls and context:
- We have a signed MSA (executed last week).
- NimbusWorks provided SOC2 attestation and insurance certificate (attached).
- No customer data will be stored by the vendor; integration reads metadata only (they confirmed in writing).
- Single deliverable SOW for the connector (attached).

Ask: can Procurement/Finance approve a temporary no-PO allowance for this single pilot (cap $7,000) so we can start work next week? If granted, we will require: monthly invoicing, evidence of payment terms, and immediate PO creation if cumulative spend exceeds the cap.

If procurement needs additional docs, I can get them on the thread. Sara, please confirm the invoice cadence and that there will be no downstream subcontracting.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0192

Attachments: NimbusWorks_SOW.pdf (application/pdf), W9_NimbusWorks.pdf (application/pdf), Insurance_CoC.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@nimbusworks.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary no-PO onboarding request — NimbusWorks (pilot)

Jordan / Marissa,

Thanks for the context. A few quick clarifications before I can sign off on any temporary exception:

1) Confirmation we have the signed MSA on file (please attach the countersigned final PDF if it's not the SOW).
2) Final invoice estimate and payment terms (Net30?), and whether Nimbus can accept electronic payment (ACH).
3) Vendor tax form (W9) and COI — I see those are attached, thx.

Operationally: I can approve a limited temporary no-PO allowance up to $5,000 for small one-off pilots on a case-by-case basis. Anything over $5,000 requires Director-level procurement approval and a short justification. If Jordan can confirm the spend is ≤ $5k, I can process today; otherwise, Marissa will need to weigh in.

Also, to be clear: temporary no-PO does not change our requirement to create a PO if cumulative spend goes beyond the approved threshold. We track these in the procurement queue.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Procurement | finance@redwood.ai

Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary no-PO onboarding request — NimbusWorks (pilot)

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick reply.

Couple of clarifications:
- SOW delivered and countersigned by legal; attaching final signed MSA now (file name: NimbusWorks_MSA_signed.pdf).
- Nimbus confirmed they accept ACH and will invoice Net30.
- Estimated pilot cost: $6,500 (one invoice). That puts us above the $5k auto-approve threshold by $1,500.

Rationale for exception:
- Time-sensitive proof-of-concept tied to a sales cycle that otherwise stalls.
- Vendor is already in our restricted vendor intake tracker and has completed security questionnaire.
- Low ongoing risk: one-time deliverable and explicit statement that no customer PII is retained.

If we can get Director-level temporary approval to $7,000 (60-day window), we will proceed and commit to immediate PO creation if we cross the threshold or continue engagement.

Sara: can you confirm the invoice will be one invoice (post-delivery) and supply the signed MSA copy to Ben directly?

Jordan

Attachments: NimbusWorks_MSA_signed.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara@nimbusworks.com>, procurement@nimbusworks.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Temporary no-PO onboarding request — NimbusWorks (pilot)

Jordan / Ben / Sara,

After reviewing the materials and risk controls: approved — temporary exception granted. Conditions below, please follow them exactly:

- Approval: temporary no-PO onboarding allowance up to $7,000 (USD) for a single pilot engagement, valid for 60 days from today (25 Sep 2027).
- Invoicing: NimbusWorks must submit a single invoice (post-delivery) with payment terms Net30. Invoice should reference Redwood deal NW-2027-03. ACH payment preferred.
- Evidence: Ben to upload signed MSA, W9, COI, and SOW to the procurement record (procurement queue id: PRQ-11258).
- Data: This approval is contingent on the vendor's written confirmation that they will not store any customer PII. If that changes, approval is rescinded immediately.
- Escalation: If cumulative spend to Redwood from NimbusWorks exceeds $7,000 within 60 days, Procurement will create a standard PO and revert billing to the normal PO path.

Ben: please log the exception and move the record to "temp-no-po-approved". Jordan: confirm once you have the final invoice and we'll route to accounts payable.

Sara — welcome aboard. If you need a faster onboarding checklist, here's a DocuSign link to sign our vendor onboarding acknowledgement: https://www.docusign.com/recipients/abc123. Once signed, Ben will close out the procurement intake.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations & Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
